summary.headline: Mercury in the Planetary Terms
summary.text: Astrological judgments for Mercury placed in the terms of Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, and Venus, describing wealth, reputation, family relations, travel, enemies, offspring, religious authority, and misfortune.
